title: Package Benefit Schedule: Rideshare Allowance Top-Up under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
**Top-up.** A package top-up is added to the daily rideshare allowance under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement. The top-up depends on the highest rental option rank that the household's Cardinal Personal Auto Policy package allows. That rank is the rank of the Cardinal Rental Reimbursement options: rank 1 is 30/900 and rank 6 is 100/3000. The topped-up allowance is never above the option's daily limit.

| Highest rental option rank the package allows | Top-up added to the daily rideshare allowance |
|---|---|
| 6 | $5.00 |
| 4 or 5 | $2.50 |
| Below 4 | Nothing |

## Worked allowances (hypothetical)

| Option on the vehicle | Daily rideshare allowance before top-up | Rank the package allows | Top-up | Topped-up allowance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100/3000 (limit $100.00) | $35.00 | 6 | $5.00 | $40.00 |
| 50/1500 (limit $50.00) | $45.00 | 6 | $5.00 | $50.00 (equals the limit) |
| 60/1800 (limit $60.00) | $35.00 | 4 | $2.50 | $37.50 |
| 40/1200 (limit $40.00) | $40.00 | 5 | $2.50 | $40.00 (held to the limit) |
| 30/900 (limit $30.00) | $30.00 | 3 | Nothing | $30.00 |
